name: r3x
label: DJ R3X (R-3X Animation mechanics + extended arms) [generated from the mech model]
_doc: GENERATED by `mech/.venv/bin/python -m rigsync` from out/r3x_droid/manifest.json - do not edit; see robot.generated.diff.md. Seeded from sim/web/src/actuation/servo_map.json + sim/web/src/show/rig_limits.json (parents and chest layout copied once from a built sim/web/public/model/rig.json). hard = mechanical joint range; soft = hard intersected with servo reach, minus the channel margin; animation = soft until authored. Units: deg or mm; v/a/j per second. Light groups for the face and chest come from the selected electronics package (profiles/electronics/<electronics>.json; R3X_ELECTRONICS overrides it).

actuators.name: neck
actuators.note: Script centre 5961 qus = 1490 us. Neck-gear ratio not yet measured (1.5 assumed).

actuators.name: headlift
actuators.note: Rack and pinion, ~12 mm pinion assumed: 0.21 mm per servo degree; 1500 us = rest (0 mm), 800-2200 us = +/-20 mm.

actuators.name: headroll
actuators.note: Hunter's head mech (mech/assemblies/hunter_head): roll about +Z at the gimbal centre, +/-12 deg to first contact. The mech is a push-rod pair: servo_l/servo_r each carry tilt AND roll (~1.6 servo deg per tilt deg, ~2.4 per roll deg, opposite signs). Modelled as an independent roll channel until the pipeline can mix two joints into one servo.

actuators.name: visor
actuators.note: Push-rod linkage treated as 1:1. Script flaps 4956 <-> 5297 qus (~11 deg).

actuators.name: elbow
actuators.note: 20 kg double-shaft servo in the hero-arm elbow disc. Script 'up' 7361 qus = rest.

actuators.name: lowarm
actuators.note: Lower ring: 22T-class servo gear into a ~98 deg internal sector (~3.8:1), carries the poker arm.

actuators.name: heroarm
actuators.note: Top ring: servo gear into a ~61 deg internal sector (~4.4:1), carries the hero arm.

actuators.name: hero_claw
actuators.note: One servo opens all three fingers.

actuators.name: middle_ring
actuators.note: Same gear sector design as the lower ring.

mech._doc: Extension block (serde ignores it): the mech model this profile was generated from. Body frame (show/SPEC.md): mm, +Y up, +Z front, +X the droid's left, rest pose. inertia = [Ixx, Iyy, Izz, Ixy, Ixz, Iyz] kg m^2 about the link COM, body axes. servo_deg_per_unit = servo deg per joint deg (the profile's calibration.gear). Links of joint null are ground.

rules.animation: soft, and margin inside first contact
rules.v_max: 0.7 x servo no-load speed at supply / ratio (driven joints)
rules.rated: stall torque at supply_volts (servos.rs); the 70% rule flags load > 0.7 x stall

drive.how: push_rod_pair at rest: servo_l -2.417, servo_r +2.418 servo deg per joint deg
push_rod_pair at rest: servo_l -0.517, servo_r -0.517 servo deg per joint deg
direct, visor_servo_l +1, visor_servo_r -1 servo deg per joint deg

links.name: Column (fixed: posts, plates, ring drives, the lift's rack)
Lift sled (V-wheels on the posts; lift and pan servos, neck bearings)
Neck: coupler, bearing hub, tube (the head rides it)
Neck post (coupler, hubs, hex shaft, U-joint body)

hunter_head/rod_l.inferred_note: Arm hole, hub hole, horn clocking and ball side chosen by design_linkage (every real-part combination tested); Hunter's actual choice is not in the sources.

hunter_head/rod_r.inferred_note: Arm hole, hub hole, horn clocking and ball side chosen by design_linkage (every real-part combination tested); Hunter's actual choice is not in the sources.

couplings.note: head_tilt's range as a function of head_roll: Hunter's 32 mm horns swing toward the head top on the side the head rolls to; every rule (reach, travel, swivel, leverage) with 1.5 mm clearance. The joint's own max is the roll-0 value.
throttle_elbow's range as a function of throttle_shoulder (throttle_wrist swept to its ends): outside it the arm comes within 1.0 mm of the body
head_tilt's range as a function of head_lift (head_roll swept to its ends): outside it the arm comes within 1.0 mm of the body
